shared_elements: arm/hand or limb rendered in relief
raised outlines against a flattened background
justification: Both are tan stone panels bearing relief carving with profile-oriented figures and a horizontal band of repeated elements running across the upper field, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is dominated by a single large, deeply modelled bearded head with dense, minutely incised surface textures (curls, scales, feathers), while B is a shallow, schematic composition of small animal and anthropomorphic forms stacked in registers on an irregular monolith, with almost no interior detailing.
